lines.t: I was walking through the silence, heavy heart, nowhere to go
Every step felt like a shadow, every breath was moving slow
I tried to hide from all the pain I couldn't face inside
But in the distance I heard love I couldn't deny
I was searching for a reason, something real to hold on to
Every road just left me empty, every dream I thought I knew
Then a whisper broke the darkness, calling me by name
And in that moment, nothing ever stayed the same
Through the storm and through the fire, you were there
Lifting higher
Yeah, who's you? I'm still calling my name
Through my brokenness you stay the same
When I fall you lift me again
My savior, my closest friend
Yahushua, your love won't let go
In the dark you're the only glow
Now I stand forever changed
Cause you kept calling my name
I remember all the nights I thought I was too far gone
Every lie I kept believing said I didn't belong
But your mercy reached deeper than the shame I held
And your truth became the story I now tell
Now I'm dancing in the freedom I was scared to find
All the chains they used to bind me left them all behind
You restored what I thought I lost for good
Turned my ashes into something beautiful
Through the valley, through the flame
Every step you stayed the same
Yahoo, sure, you're still calling my name
Through my brokenness you stayed the same
When I fall you lift me again
My savior, my closest friend
Yahushua, your love won't let go
In the dark you're the only glow
Now I stand for every change
Cause you kept calling my name
I hear you in the silence
I see you in the storm
Every time I lose my way
You lead me home
Praise that never leaves me
Love that sets me free
Yahushua
You're everything I'll ever need
Yahushua
You're still calling my name
Through my brokenness you'll stay the same
When I fall you lift me again
My savior, my closest friend
Yahushua, your love won't let go

Now I stand forever changed
Forever I'll praise your name
You kept calling
You kept calling me
Yahushua, I'm finally free
